::: {#sol-envelope}

Yes.
Start at $v$ and follow

$$
v, w, x, v, y, x, z, y, w.
$$

This draws each of the eight lines once:
$\set{v, w}$, $\set{w, x}$, $\set{x, v}$, $\set{v, y}$, $\set{y, x}$, $\set{x, z}$, $\set{z, y}$ and $\set{y, w}$.
It is a trail (@def-trail) that uses every edge of the graph.

:::
